decisions.question: Flatten Robinhood physical learning lots, or keep the Monday market sells?
decisions.proposal: Flatten RH physical learning lots tonight.
decisions.options: Flatten all RH physical lots tonight · KEEP Monday market sells on CEG/ETN/PWR/GEV/HUBB/VRT · Flatten some, keep others
decisions.decision: KEEP Monday market sells on CEG/ETN/PWR/GEV/HUBB/VRT. Do not flatten the physical learning lots tonight.
decisions.rationale: Learning lots stay on the board as funded Robinhood physicals. Monday open sells are the written exit. Flattening tonight would erase the live experiment before the planned market action.
decisions.outcome: Call locked. Monday market sells are queued — not filled. Queued ≠ filled.
decisions.evidence: Robinhood holdings snapshot of CEG/ETN/PWR/GEV/HUBB/VRT learning lots; Monday sell instructions already locked for market open.
decisions.reviewTrigger: After Monday session — confirm fills, leftover quantity, and whether any ticker should remain a funded node.

decisions.question: Lock the Phase Zero Agentic charter for Robinhood Ops?
decisions.proposal: Lock the Phase Zero Agentic charter (constrained agent).
decisions.options: Lock charter (constrained agent) · Delay · Unlock full autonomy now
decisions.decision: Lock the Phase Zero Agentic charter. Agentic may operate only inside the written charter. Later superseded by D-2026-09-11-04 for trading autonomy — keep this row as the historical lock.
decisions.rationale: Phase Zero stays human-governed. A written charter is the record before any agentic trading. This lock is the original call; D-2026-09-11-04 is the later autonomy unlock.
decisions.outcome: Charter was locked, then superseded by D-2026-09-11-04 for trading autonomy. Kept as historical record. No trades executed from this row.
decisions.evidence: Phase Zero human-governed scope; Resonance web app does not execute trades; hub/chat charter text.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Superseded by D-2026-09-11-04. Re-open only if the charter itself is rewritten.

decisions.question: Approve Agentic buys of PWR $35 and VRT $17 at Monday open?
decisions.proposal: Agentic PWR $35 + VRT $17 at Monday open.
decisions.options: Approve both · Approve PWR only · Approve VRT only · Reject · Delay
decisions.decision: Approve Agentic PWR $35 + VRT $17 Monday open.
decisions.rationale: Sized, named, Monday-open entries. Does not tap Main or Xaman treasury principal. Sits on top of D-2026-09-11-01 (learning lots / Monday sells stay).
decisions.outcome: PWR $35 and VRT $17 are QUEUED for Monday open — not filled. Queued ≠ filled.
decisions.evidence: Written size ($35 PWR, $17 VRT); Agentic Robinhood Ops only; Monday open timing. No fill recorded.
decisions.reviewTrigger: After Monday open — confirm fills, residual cash, and whether either ticker needs a new decision.

decisions.question: Unlock full Agentic autonomy for Robinhood Ops?
decisions.proposal: Unlock FULL Agentic autonomy for Robinhood Ops (Agentic only).
decisions.options: Unlock full Agentic autonomy (Agentic only) · Keep D-2026-09-11-02 charter · Unlock including Main/Xaman (rejected)
decisions.decision: Unlock FULL Agentic autonomy for Robinhood Ops. Agentic account only. Main + Xaman treasury principal remain off-limits.
decisions.rationale: Trading autonomy is granted to Agentic only. This supersedes D-2026-09-11-02 for trading autonomy. It does not authorize spending Xaman treasury principal or the founder Main account. Agentic may trade ETN and GEV under this unlock.
decisions.outcome: Autonomy unlocked for Agentic Robinhood Ops only. Agentic autonomy trades ETN/GEV under this row. PWR/VRT (D-03) and ETN/GEV (D-04) are QUEUED for Monday open — not filled. No Main or Xaman principal movement. No on-chain write.
decisions.evidence: Founder lock tonight; Phase Zero Web2 record only — no wallet signing, no on-chain write. ETN/GEV autonomy tickets sit on the Agentic sleeve, not Main.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Any proposed touch of Main or Xaman treasury principal; material Agentic loss; or a new written charter.
